name: Productboard
summary: Product management platform for feedback and roadmaps.

flows.title: Add a feature
steps: From the Main menu, click Library, then Products, then Product hierarchy.
Hover over a product or component, click the Add under button, and select Add feature.
Give the feature a name. Press Enter/Return to create another, or click away to stop.

flows.title: Submit feedback
steps: Open an insights board. Main menu, then Library, then Feedback is easiest.
Click the Submit feedback button at the bottom of the board.
Give the feedback a short title that describes its source, and identify the company or user it came from.
Optionally add tags. Write the feedback in the empty field below.
Optionally make someone else the owner with the Owner button in the bottom-left corner.
Feedback autosaves, so click away or close the item when done.

flows.title: Share a roadmap by link
steps: In the top right corner of the roadmap, click Share, then Publish.
Switch on Publish this board. This is what publishes it: anyone who clicks the link can then see the published view of the board.
With publication on, click Share, then Publish, then Copy link to copy the URL from the Publish tab.
